description: The file defines the 'Adamax' optimizer class for the PyTorch library, implementing the Adamax optimization algorithm with related functions and detailed docstrings. It includes initialization, state management, and the core update step, and references internal and external PyTorch components.

classes.name: Adamax
classes.description: A PyTorch optimizer class implementing the Adamax optimization algorithm, supporting customizable hyperparameters such as learning rate, betas, epsilon, weight decay, and flags for foreach, maximize, differentiable, and capturable modes. Contains methods for state initialization and performing optimizer steps.
